description: This file defines the MigrateDestinationInterface interface for Drupal migration destination plugins, including method signatures for getting IDs, fields, importing, rollback, and related functionalities.

classes.name: MigrateDestinationInterface
classes.description: Interface for migration destination classes, extending PluginInspectionInterface, defining methods for handling destination data in Drupal migrations.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns an array of destination IDs with field definitions for migration primary keys.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array of available destination fields with descriptions.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Imports a row into the destination, constructing a new object with ID mappings.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Deletes a specified destination object from Drupal.

methods.name: supportsRollback
methods.description: Indicates if rollback is supported for the destination.

methods.name: rollbackAction
methods.description: Returns the rollback action constant for the last imported item.

methods.name: getDestinationModule
methods.description: Returns the module handling the destination data.
